info.title: Static_Multicast_Nexthop
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

ip_address.description: IP address of the nexthop device. If both ip address and port are specified, then IP address takes precedence and port is ignored.

ip_prefix.description:
Reference Resource: [Static_Multicast_Nexthop](#/Static_Multicast_Nexthop)
Overrides normal RPF lookup mechanism for multicast routes matching ip_prefix IP-ADDR/MASK-LEN with the gateway ip/port

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Egress port of the nexthop. If both ip address and port are specified, then IP address takes precedence and port is ignored.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: PIM_Router.ip_version
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router)
PIM router entries keyed by IP version. This can have one [PIM_Router](#/PIM_Router) entry per IP version. If this is not set, then PIM will be disabled on this VRF.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
